notes.title: Highway Madness Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

We have released a new update and applied some minor fixes to the game.

- FIXES:

- We have noticed that some of our users were experiencing a black screen window when trying to return to the main menu.

- We made some adjustment on the win scene rank UI.

Thank you all for your support, and enjoy the game.

- THE GAME COOKS TEAM

notes.title: Highway Madness update V2.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’ve been working relentlessly to polish the game you love and to add new juicy stuff! Here’s what’s new on the streets of highway madness in this version:

- New refreshed interface to keep things clear and easy for ya’ll.
- Character selection will immediately modify your looks! To keep your style on flare ;)
- We combined the standoff maps into one to triple the fun, and the guns are now attached to the player’s hips (On special request from the sheriff).
- Cars in the run race mode are now slowed down by 25%, keep the highway safer but the adrenaline fired up.
- Minor bug fixes.

Make sure to jump on the Highway Madness Discord Channel to chat with the devs, give your feedback and meet other Highway Madness players. We're waiting for you here: https://discord.gg/wqB4Uzt

notes.title: Highway Madness Standoff Update - NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

We've just wrapped up a crazy day and have finally pushed our biggest update to Highway Madness yet! We will be adding to the store page new visuals and gameplay video that shows the gameplay additions shortly so bare with us! Until then you'll just have to take our word for it :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31635026/a3423e6ac0804b5471683c3139fce6fad7dbc204.jpg[/img]

Here is what you can find new in this version:

- Voice chat
- 7 new characters to choose from 
- New game mode #1: Roof jumping mode that goes on for one single round
- New game mode #2: Standoff 1vs 1 - western style but modernized!
- An added new and bigger shooting arena
- One main Lobby: where you can interact with all online players in Highway Madness
- Go for a quick match with random players or host a game and invite your steam friends

This is an AWESOME update, and keep in mind the game is still in Early Access so if you encounter any bugs or issues, please make sure to let us know in the comments or reach out to us directly on our Highway Madness Discord channel: https://discord.gg/wqB4Uzt

Your feedback is extremely valuable and thank you for being on this journey with us to building a kickass game out of Highway Madness! 

Enjoy :)
Game Cooks Team

notes.title: Highway Madness - Standoff update going live this Thursday!
notes.content:
Highway Madness is getting its biggest update yet!

With this new update, the game gets bigger and better - a social game where you get to play with old and new friends from all over the world! Pick your character then choose from a wider selection of fun games including the original Road Crossing and Shootout and the newly added Standoff and Roof Jumping!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31635026/a3423e6ac0804b5471683c3139fce6fad7dbc204.jpg[/img]

With the game taking on new heights and ambitions, its still hard for us to believe that this game was just a side project for us only a few months ago - a project we used to get more familiar with multiplayer in VR! It was just too much to keep it on our VR “shelves” and we decided to share it on the Steam store for free for all VR players to enjoy and get a kick out of it.

Little did we know that this little project of ours would gather over 20,000 in less than a month since launch! We've been overwhelmed with the positive feedback, feature recommendations and support we've received since and this is our way of giving back with an update that will not disappoint, one that we believe is enough to take Highway Madness into more VR headsets! Tomorrow, you can expect to find the following:

- 7 new characters to choose from 
- New game mode #1: Roof jumping mode that goes on for one single round
- New game mode #2: Standoff 1vs 1 - western style but modernised!
- An added new and bigger shooting arena
- One main Lobby: where you can interact with all online players in Highway Madness
- Go for a quick match with random players or host a game and invite your steam friends

This update is set to go live as soon as tomorrow! So stay tuned and make sure to stay in touch on our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/wqB4Uzt

Peace out,
Game Cooks Team
